column3: The Hebrew names the seat of elders; BSB says council.
The Hebrew has a singular pool of water; BSB has pools.
The Hebrew makes the people produce fruit as a coordinated action; BSB makes vineyards the subject that yield.
The Hebrew says He sets families like sheep without an explicit increase; BSB says increases their families.
The Hebrew starts with a singular wise person but ends with a plural considering verb; BSB keeps the singular throughout.
